execution_order: stop the prior P4-D isolated server without deleting its runtime
start a newly created P4-E isolated root on localhost with the sandboxed P4-B launcher
submit exactly session_1.input in Safari and wait for durable turn completion
record old PID session id runtime root memory path and conversation row
terminate the old product process and prove it exited
start once with --reuse-runtime on the same P4-E root and record a different PID
reload the same Safari product tab and record a different product session id
confirm the browser-only VRM stage returned to waiting_for_local_vrm
record visible reply selected speaker memory id trace id planner path graph node and call accounting
run the frozen gate once and preserve pass or fail

failure_policy.repair_after_terminal_result: new separately reviewed case only; the P4-E result remains immutable

claim_boundary: This freeze authorizes one product restart acceptance case. It is not a fresh research holdout and cannot establish general memory or a scientific advantage.
